issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'Jehonathan son of Shimei, David's brother' (בֶּן שמעי אֲחִי דָוִד). The Chinese renders '大衛的弟兄希瑪利人的兒子約拿單' which swaps the order: it says 'David's brother, son of Shim'ei' instead of 'son of Shim'ei, David's brother'. Also '希瑪利' is an incorrect transliteration of 'Shimei' (שִׁמְעִי), which should be '示每' or similar, not '希瑪利'.
